scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build:all && node backend/dist/index.js
scripts.dev:backend: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run dev --prefix backend
scripts.vercel-build: npm run setup && npm run build:frontend
